name: Bob Thompson
role: Bad Lands man accused of horse theft
bio: Bob Thompson left the Bad Lands in August 1886, and the paper first reported he had taken four of the best horses of the 13 outfit. In September the 13 camp reported no horses missing, so the paper withdrew the charge.

moments.label: Reported to have stolen four horses
Theft report contradicted by the 13 camp
